name: Huff 'n Puff
notes: Own site lists products with prices and has a 'Find Our Locations' link, but no weekly market schedule was visible in search results. Listed as a participant at the Honolulu Festival in 2024 and 2025. Brand writes the name 'Huff n Puff' or 'Huff n' Puff'. Based on Oʻahu (Hawaiʻi-made listing: https://invest.hawaii.gov/hawaii-made/org/huff-n-puff/). No Instagram or Facebook page found that I could tie to this business. The order_url is the site's own product pages and I did not confirm checkout.

name: JJz Treats
notes: Business spells itself 'JJz Treatz' (LLC: JJ'Z Treatz). It is based in Waiʻanae (85-993 Farrington Hwy, Suite 203) and sells li hing mui and candy online. It is on the Plenty of Aloha Windward Mall Farmers Market vendor list. That market runs Wednesday 2-6 pm and Sunday 10 am-2 pm, but the list does not say which days this vendor attends. An Eventeny profile shows it at a Waiʻanae event on Dec 13, 2025 (https://www.eventeny.com/company/?c=398281). No Instagram or Facebook found.

name: Kapuakea Bakery
notes: Listed as 'Kapuakea Bakery' on the Plenty of Aloha Windward Mall market vendor list. A similarly named pre-order bakery, Kapuakea Products (439 Kamani St, Honolulu; website kapuakeaproducts.com; Facebook https://www.facebook.com/KapuakeaProducts/), exists. I could not confirm it is the same business as the Windward Mall vendor, so I left its handles null. Also, the vendor list is undated, so I could not tell if the vendor is current.

name: Kuumeli Bakery
notes: Business is written 'Kuʻumeli Bakery'. A KHON2 story from about mid-2026 says it pops up at Windward Mall every Wednesday 2-6 pm and Sunday 10 am-2 pm, and that founder Hailey Goodhue hopes to open a storefront eventually. The website URL comes from a Yahoo Local listing, not a page I opened. A Marketspread vendor page mentions an Instagram contact but gives no handle, so Instagram is null. No Facebook found.

name: Kynd Tea
notes: The matcha and tea vendor appears at Fishcake, 307C Kamani St, Kakaʻako, in 2025 event pages (e.g. https://www.fishcake.us/event-details/any-kine-swap). The Instagram handle comes only from an aggregator listing for this business, so it is not directly verified. A Facebook page 'Kynd Tea' (kyndtea.com, botanical blends and infusers) exists. I could not tie it to the Honolulu matcha vendor, so Facebook and website are null. Last dated evidence is July 2025.

name: La Tour Bakery
notes: Official name is La Tour Bakehouse. Based at 888 N Nimitz Hwy, Honolulu 96817, with a retail shop (Ste 105) open daily 7am-7pm. The 'Where to find us' page says products are sold at farmers markets and grocers across Hawaiʻi but gives no specific market days. The X account @LaTourBakehouse is stale (2013 posts). No Instagram found. The seed's 'East Honolulu' does not match the Nimitz Hwy base; it may reflect KCC farmers market attendance.

name: Lilypad Bakery
notes: Searched but found no own site, social accounts or organizer listing for an Oʻahu business of this name.

name: Lisa's Little Loaves
notes: Searched but found nothing for this business. A 'Little's Loaves' Facebook page appeared, but nothing links it to this vendor or to Oʻahu, so I did not use it.

name: Manny's Bake Shop
notes: Business is Manny's Bakeshop (& Restaurant), 94-226 Leoku St, Waipahu, (808) 686-9898, which sells Filipino pastries. The Facebook page shows a Windward Mall Farmer's Market post and a craft-fair booth post, which supports the market link, but both are undated. No own website found (lookintohawaii.com is a directory). Waipahu is leeward/ewa, while the seed side is Windward, likely because of the Windward Mall market. No Instagram found.

name: Munchie Factory Hawaii
notes: Listed as 'Munchie Factory Hawai`i' on the Plenty of Aloha Windward Mall vendor list (market Wednesday 2-6 pm, Sunday 10 am-2 pm; vendor's own days not stated). The Instagram bio reads 'Munchie Factory Hawaii', established 2022, Hawaiʻi-made snacks. Facebook page 'munchie_factory_hi' mentions pipikaula and kalbi deliveries from Hawaiʻi Kai to Pearl City. Neither account is dated. alohamunchiezfactory.com (li hing gummies) is a different business and was not used. The Munchie Machine food truck is also unrelated.

name: Oahu Food Company
notes: Only found on the Plenty of Aloha Windward Mall market vendor list as 'O`ahu Food Company'. No own website or social accounts found. Oahu Food Hub / Oahu Fresh is a different entity and was not used. The vendor list is undated.

name: Ono Kettle Pop
notes: The Facebook page lists 4 active weekly markets: Sun Mililani HS 8-11am, Wed Blaisdell 4-7pm, Thu Kailua (across Longs) 4-7pm, Sat KCC 7:30-11:15am. The post is undated, so the schedule may have changed. The page says to use 'SHOP NOW' on the website for pickup and delivery orders. The website describes a 100% mobile kettle corn business on Oʻahu. No Instagram found. Based in Honolulu (96819).

name: Ono Kuki Company
notes: The Instagram bio reads 'Handmade Small Batch Bakery Honolulu, Hawaii' (113 posts, undated). The Hawaiʻi Farm Bureau page lists KCC on the 2nd and 4th Saturdays and Mililani on the 1st and 3rd Sundays, but that page is old (about 3.5 years), so treat the schedule as possibly outdated. The website URL is from third-party listings and the Farm Bureau page. A Kauaʻi 'Kauai Ono Kuki Company' appears in older results and is unrelated. No Facebook found.

name: PJ Smoke Meat
notes: A June 2026 Hawaii News Now story features this Kaneʻohe family business at the Windward Mall market on Wednesdays 2-6 pm and Sundays 10 am-2 pm, and tells viewers to follow its Instagram. The handle @pjsmokemeat comes from a third-party TikTok caption about 'PJ's smoked meat' (https://www.tiktok.com/discover/hawaiian-smoked-meat-recipe). It matches the business name but is not confirmed from the business's own page. No Facebook or website found.
